label: Illustrative example: Storefront Studio with three storefronts, each with its own domain, its last publication, changes waiting and what needs a look.
title: Storefronts
subtitle: Each storefront has its own domain, theme, pages and assortment.

items.title: 1 error blocks v9 of Bright Harbour Trade
items.body: An image has no description. Fix it before the release can be approved.

items.title: 2 items sold out at the main store
items.body: They show as sold out on the shop and on the till at once.

items.title: Domain not verified for Harbour Electrics
items.body: Connect your own domain or buy one. The certificate follows when it is verified.

items.label: Good to know
items.value: Publishing a storefront never changes stock, prices or orders. Those stay in the ERP and are read when a shopper visits.
